n67e7ca78f7.headline: Pakistan opens mining sector to US, China & Russia with equal bidding rights
n67e7ca78f7.summary: Pakistan has invited companies from the United States, China and Russia to bid for multibillion-dollar mining contracts, including the Reko Diq gold and copper project. The government says all foreign investors will have equal bidding rights.
n67e7ca78f7.why: Pakistan has large untapped mineral reserves, and opening mining tenders to major powers could attract capital to its resource sector. Reko Diq is one of the country's largest gold and copper projects.

ndd2dc4134a.headline: Fuel Prices in the First Half of the Year in Free Fall
ndd2dc4134a.summary: A VCÖ fuel price report shows average prices for gasoline and diesel decreased in the first half of the year in Austria. The report is a periodic transport-sector price survey.
ndd2dc4134a.why: Fuel prices feed into transport costs, inflation and household spending. The VCÖ is an Austrian transport-policy think tank whose reports track pump prices.

ne4c3a6246e.headline: Naira pressures dollar again: New exchange rate emerges after IMF applause
ne4c3a6246e.summary: The Nigerian naira has held pressure on the dollar for a fifth consecutive day, and the Central Bank of Nigeria has released a new exchange rate. The move follows recent praise from the IMF.
ne4c3a6246e.why: The naira's exchange rate sets import costs and inflation expectations in Nigeria, Africa's largest economy by GDP. The central bank's official rate influences foreign-exchange availability for businesses.

n8d56c88a9d.headline: CBZ secures US$200m in credit lines for year 2025
n8d56c88a9d.summary: Zimbabwe's CBZ has secured US$200 million in credit lines for 2025, short of its US$500 million target for the year. The bank had aimed to tackle the country's liquidity challenges.
n8d56c88a9d.why: CBZ is one of Zimbabwe's largest commercial banks, and access to foreign credit lines affects its ability to fund lending. Liquidity constraints are a central concern for Zimbabwean businesses.

n658fd0fc14.headline: British Pound Retreats After Recent Rally
n658fd0fc14.summary: The GBP/USD pair is correcting lower toward 1.1627 on Friday, its lowest level since June 23 this year. The pullback follows a recent rally in sterling.
n658fd0fc14.why: Sterling is the currency of the United Kingdom and a major global traded currency, so its moves against the dollar affect UK importers and multinational earnings. GBP/USD is one of the most widely traded currency pairs.

n2cdf2fc1af.headline: Why is the dollar off to a weak start this year?
n2cdf2fc1af.summary: The US dollar had its worst start to a year in more than half a century, according to a report citing Harvard economist Kenneth Rogoff. Rogoff says President Trump is accelerating the decline.
n2cdf2fc1af.why: The dollar's value affects commodity prices, multinational earnings and global capital flows, since it is the main reserve currency. Its trend is a key macro variable for investors.

n795eb44508.headline: US debt is now $37tn – should we be worried?
n795eb44508.summary: US national debt has reached $37 trillion, and President Trump's budget bill will add to the total. The article asks how much the rest of the world will continue to lend to the US.
n795eb44508.why: US Treasury debt is the benchmark safe asset for global markets, and its issuance and demand set global interest rates. Debt levels affect investor confidence in US fiscal policy.

n2159d54bd1.headline: Israel believes Iranian nuclear program was set back by years
n2159d54bd1.summary: Israeli military intelligence assesses that its military campaign against Iran set back Tehran's nuclear programme by years. Iran is reported to be seeking help from Russia and China.
n2159d54bd1.why: Iran's nuclear programme and its regional conflicts shape oil-market risk premiums, sanctions exposure and broader Middle East security.

nf5cc210f98.headline: Construction company VolkerWessels to sell Dutch divisions to HAL and Boskalis
nf5cc210f98.summary: The Dutch operations of VolkerWessels are being taken over by investment firm HAL and dredging provider Boskalis. VolkerWessels owner Reggeborgh has reached an agreement in principle on the deal.
nf5cc210f98.why: Boskalis is a Dutch dredging and maritime services group, and HAL is an investment firm. Deals like this reshape consolidation in the European construction and infrastructure sector.

nd4049fd176.headline: Air force to get new eyes in the sky
nd4049fd176.summary: Malaysia will acquire two maritime patrol aircraft for its air force under a venture with Italian defence firm Leonardo, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said.
nd4049fd176.why: Leonardo is an Italian aerospace and defence group, and such contracts shape its order backlog and defence spending.

impacts.name: Leonardo
impacts.why: The venture with Malaysia adds defence aircraft business for Leonardo.

nd72f6ba94e.headline: Kenya records 4.9 pct growth in Q1 2025
nd72f6ba94e.summary: Kenya's economy remained steady at 4.9% growth in the first quarter of 2025 compared with the same period a year earlier, the national statistics bureau said on Thursday.
nd72f6ba94e.why: GDP growth is the broadest measure of an economy's health and guides investor views on sovereign credit, currency and business conditions in a market.

nb468bf9eb1.headline: THL guidance, future earnings impacted by US
nb468bf9eb1.summary: Tourism Holdings expects underlying net profit after tax for the year to June to be at the lower end of analysts' expectations, closer to $27 million than $34.4 million. The company cited the US.
nb468bf9eb1.why: Tourism Holdings is a New Zealand operator of campervan rentals and holiday parks, so its earnings depend heavily on international travel demand.

ncaa1ab02b8.headline: RBI Brings Big Relief For Borrowers, No Charges On Early Loan Repayment From January 2026
ncaa1ab02b8.summary: The Reserve Bank of India removed prepayment charges on floating-rate personal loans. The new rules apply from January 1, 2026, to boost borrower flexibility and transparency.
ncaa1ab02b8.why: The Reserve Bank of India is the central bank that regulates lenders, and prepayment rules affect loan repayment patterns and banks' retail lending income.

n174f0f49c9.headline: What the new tax laws mean for you if you earn ₦1M+ monthly
n174f0f49c9.summary: New Nigerian tax laws place people earning N1 million or more monthly in a different bracket, with reforms affecting take-home pay.
n174f0f49c9.why: Tax reforms change household disposable income and government revenue, which feed into consumer demand and fiscal planning.

n61c0520224.headline: Exclusive-China signals investment in Brazil-led global forest fund, sources say
n61c0520224.summary: China has signaled to Brazil's government that it will invest in the Tropical Forests Forever Facility, a multilateral fund for endangered forest conservation. The information comes from sources.
n61c0520224.why: The fund is a multilateral mechanism that pools capital for forest conservation, so large sovereign contributions shape its size and governance.

n83b7aec2cd.headline: US-India Trade: Pact To Be Finalised Before July 9,Issues With Agriculture & Auto Sectors To Be Resolved
n83b7aec2cd.summary: India and the US are in the final phase of trade talks, with a pact expected before July 9, when the 90-day suspension of Trump tariffs ends. Agriculture and auto issues are still being resolved.
n83b7aec2cd.why: Bilateral trade deals set tariff levels on large flows of goods, affecting exporters, importers and currencies in both economies.

n02ffb2ea29.headline: PCA agrees deal to acquire Greif Containerboard for $1.8 bln in third major containerboard M&A deal
n02ffb2ea29.summary: Packaging Corporation of America agreed to acquire Greif's containerboard business for $1.8 billion. Fastmarkets described it as the third major containerboard M&A deal.
n02ffb2ea29.why: Packaging Corporation of America is a major US maker of containerboard and corrugated packaging, so acquisitions reshape supply and pricing in that industry.

naad086b4ad.headline: Zenith Bank Retains Top Spot in Nigeria by Tier-1 Capital for 16th Year
naad086b4ad.summary: Zenith Bank retained its position as Nigeria's top bank by Tier-1 capital for the 16th consecutive year, ranking 581st globally.
naad086b4ad.why: Tier-1 capital measures a bank's core financial strength and its ability to absorb losses, which matters for lenders' credit ratings and capital.

n43479fc77c.headline: BSE Schedules Mock Trading For Equity Segment, Members Invited To Test Systems On July 5
n43479fc77c.summary: BSE will conduct a mock trading session for its equity segment on July 5, 2025, letting members test systems, trading platforms and market scenarios for SEBI compliance.
n43479fc77c.why: Mock trading sessions verify exchange systems before live operations, supporting market reliability for Indian equity investors.

n191df2246e.headline: Millions of Brits 'face working until 74' in State Pension triple lock warning
n191df2246e.summary: Millions of Britons could face working until 74, as the State Pension age may have to increase to keep up with government funding promises under the triple lock.
n191df2246e.why: The State Pension is the UK government's main retirement income guarantee, and its funding and eligibility age shape public finances and labour supply.

n98b832eb6d.headline: UK home building returns to growth as demand lifts
n98b832eb6d.summary: UK housebuilding returned to growth as demand rose, following a boost from first-time buyers rushing to complete purchases before stamp duty relief was cut.
n98b832eb6d.why: Housebuilding activity is a key indicator of UK construction and economic momentum, and it is sensitive to tax policy and mortgage conditions.

nddfc525257.headline: President Trump takes victory lap after Congress passes tax cut and policy bill
nddfc525257.summary: Congress passed President Trump's tax cut and policy bill, and he has planned a signing ceremony for July Fourth after touting the measure in Iowa.
nddfc525257.why: US tax legislation affects corporate earnings, household income, and federal deficits, which in turn influence Treasury yields and equity markets.

n2aea772251.headline: IAR Soars on Takeover Bid, OMXS30 Index Drops 0.9 Percent
n2aea772251.summary: IAR shares soared on a takeover bid while the OMXS30 index dropped 0.9 percent at midday Friday. The Stockholm market mirrored weakness on leading European exchanges amid second-quarter reports.
n2aea772251.why: OMXS30 tracks the 30 most traded shares on the Nasdaq Stockholm exchange, the main benchmark for Swedish equities. Takeover bids can revalue a target company and reflect deal activity in the market.

impacts.name: OMXS30
impacts.why: The benchmark index fell 0.9 percent at midday, in line with weakness across European exchanges.

n2c175fe53c.headline: ‘Signs of recovery’: Toronto-area home prices drop more than 5 per cent since last June
n2c175fe53c.summary: Greater Toronto Area home sales fell 2.4% in June year on year to 6,243 properties, while new listings rose. Prices have dropped more than 5% since last June.
n2c175fe53c.why: Housing prices and sales drive household wealth, mortgage credit quality and the outlook for Canadian banks and construction.

n6efd78910f.headline: No short-term recovery expected in housing market, says MJ Gleeson
n6efd78910f.summary: Homebuilder MJ Gleeson said profits over the past year were hit by planning delays, the absence of a market recovery and rising costs, and it expects no short-term recovery.
n6efd78910f.why: MJ Gleeson is an Australian housebuilder whose earnings track residential construction activity and approvals. Its outlook reflects conditions across Australia's housing sector.

nb10553b3c5.headline: Stocks, Dollar Drop As Tariff Talk Dominates
nb10553b3c5.summary: Stock markets mostly fell alongside a retreating dollar on Friday as international tensions over tariffs dominated sentiment.
nb10553b3c5.why: Tariff disputes affect trade flows, corporate margins and currency demand, so they are a central driver of global market sentiment.
nb10553b3c5.why_moved: Tariff tensions dominated investor sentiment, and the article reports stocks and the dollar both falling on Friday.

nf772073bbd.headline: Trump to start sending tariff letters; global duties to begin Aug 1
nf772073bbd.summary: The US administration will begin sending letters to trading partners with their tariff rates as soon as Friday, as negotiations enter the final stretch, Trump said. He said 10-12 countries will receive letters.
nf772073bbd.why: US tariffs affect global trade flows, corporate margins and currency markets. Announcements on duty rates for major trading partners are closely watched by investors across asset classes.
nf772073bbd.why_moved: Tariff letters with rates set to range widely across 10-12 countries add uncertainty to trade costs. Investors typically reprice trade-exposed assets when new duties are announced.

n066a1cf524.headline: Bolivia inflation soars to 34-year high ahead of August election
n066a1cf524.summary: Bolivia's inflation rate reached its fastest pace in more than three decades, driven by a dollar shortage, fuel scarcity and mass unrest ahead of the general election.
n066a1cf524.why: Inflation and currency shortages shape the returns and risks for investors in Bolivia's economy, which relies on gas exports and foreign exchange availability.

n4bb985d409.headline: Higher Metro Manila inflation possible after P50 wage bump, says PSA
n4bb985d409.summary: Higher inflation rates in Metro Manila are possible in the coming months following implementation of a P50 daily wage hike, the Philippine Statistics Authority said.
n4bb985d409.why: Inflation influences the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas' interest rate decisions, which affect Philippine bond yields and the peso. The Philippine Statistics Authority compiles the country's official price data.

n3622fc64c0.headline: Germany's €25B Military Upgrade for NATO Readiness
n3622fc64c0.summary: Germany plans a €25 billion military procurement package including tanks and armored vehicles. The move is intended to boost NATO readiness amid rising Russian threats.
n3622fc64c0.why: Large defence procurement shapes order books for domestic and foreign military suppliers and reflects a shift in European government spending.

n3b02ad25ff.headline: India-EFTA trade pact likely to be implemented in next couple of months: Piyush Goyal
n3b02ad25ff.summary: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said the India-EFTA trade agreement could take effect in a couple of months. The deal involves $100 billion of investment in India.
n3b02ad25ff.why: EFTA comprises Switzerland, Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein, and trade pacts shape tariff access and investment flows for Indian exporters.

n9ccdc5f4bd.headline: Gold gets cheaper in Pakistan as per tola price down by Rs1500
n9ccdc5f4bd.summary: Gold prices in Pakistan fell in local and international markets on Friday, according to the Saraffa Association. The decline brought some relief to potential buyers.
n9ccdc5f4bd.why: Gold is a traditional store of value, and local prices in Pakistan track global bullion prices adjusted for the rupee exchange rate.

n2ef9d2d50e.headline: The bullish trend in the stock exchange continues today, the index touches a new high.
n2ef9d2d50e.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange extended a bullish trend for a second day, with the KSE 100 index trading above 131,000 points after opening 253 points higher.
n2ef9d2d50e.why: The KSE 100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking the largest listed companies in Pakistan.
n2ef9d2d50e.why_moved: The index opened with a 253-point gain on the last trading day of the week and extended a bullish trend for a second consecutive day.

n84b6d3945b.headline: Indonesia to shift LPG imports from Middle East to US
n84b6d3945b.summary: Indonesia plans to reduce liquefied petroleum gas imports from the Middle East and increase procurement from the United States, according to Antara News.
n84b6d3945b.why: Liquefied petroleum gas is a traded energy commodity, and shifts in import sources affect freight costs and regional supply.

n81b32d809b.headline: Indonesia maintains lowest debt ratio among G20 members: Minister
n81b32d809b.summary: Finance Minister Sri Mulyani Indrawati said Indonesia's debt ratio is considered the lowest among G20 member countries.
n81b32d809b.why: A country's debt ratio is a key measure of fiscal health that sovereign bond investors use to assess credit risk.
